meta.topic: 剪映 · 时间线隐藏功能

scenes.title_cn: 多时间线=多个独立工作区
scenes.context: 时间线左上角加号图标可新建多条时间线，相当于多个独立工作区互不干扰。改坏版本回不去？先Command+C复制全部素材，新建时间线后Command+V粘贴，原版永远保留。
sentences: 点击它就会在当前项目里新建一条时间线，甚至三条多条都可以。相当于给你多个独立的工作区，而且互不干扰。
Click it and it creates a new timeline in the current project — you can even make three or more. It's like having several independent workspaces that never interfere with each other.
independent workspaces（独立工作区）
你可以在修改第二个版本之前，用鼠标先选中所有素材，按Command加C复制，然后新建一条时间线，把原来的片段用Command加V粘贴过来。
Before you start on the second version, select all your clips, hit Command-C to copy, open a new timeline, and paste them over with Command-V.
hit Command-C（按下 Command-C）
这样一来第一条保留原版，其他几条放心大胆的改。
That way the first timeline keeps the original, and you can freely experiment on the others.
keep the original（保留原版）
paraphrase: Once you edit past it, there's no going back.
Experiment without worrying about breaking anything.
scenes.speak: Click it and it creates a new timeline in the current project — you can even make three or more. It's like having several independent workspaces that never interfere with each other. Before you start on the second version, select all your clips, hit Command-C to copy, open a new timeline, and paste them over with Command-V. That way the first timeline keeps the original, and you can freely experiment on the others.

scenes.context: 鼠标模式切换到分割模式，快捷键B在播放头处左键切割；选中素材按Command+B可多轨道同步分割。左括号/右括号=向左全选/向右全选，选中某片段即选中它及一侧所有片段。
sentences: 在分割模式下，将播放头移动到想要切割的位置，用鼠标左键即可完成分割。
In blade mode, move the playhead to where you want to cut, and a left-click finishes the cut.
blade mode（分割模式）
如果想同时分割多个轨道上的素材，可以先选中素材，再使用快捷键Command加B。
To cut clips on several tracks at once, select them first, then use the shortcut Command-B.
at once（同时）
按一下左括号，然后在某个片段上点击鼠标左键，就能选中这个片段以及它左侧的所有片段。
Press the left bracket, then click on a clip, and it selects that clip plus everything to its left.
everything to its left（它左侧的所有片段）
paraphrase: One track with B, every track with Command-B.
Select a whole run of clips in one click.
scenes.speak: In blade mode, move the playhead to where you want to cut, and a left-click finishes the cut. To cut clips on several tracks at once, select them first, then use the shortcut Command-B. Press the left bracket, then click on a clip, and it selects that clip plus everything to its left.

scenes.title_en: Markers: Sticky Notes and Beat Mapping
scenes.context: 标记两种用法：①不选中任何素材，播放头移到时间标尺位置点击标记=贴便利贴，鼠标停上去看内容；②先选中音频再点标记=给音乐踩点，音频上出现节奏点，剪视频照着卡点。
sentences: 你可以理解成在时间线上贴了一张便利贴。比如我们可以标记一个加个特效怕它等一下忘记。
Think of it as sticking a sticky note onto the timeline. For example, mark a spot where you want to add an effect before you forget.
sticky note（便利贴）
先选中音频素材，再点标记，这样就能对音乐进行踩点。
Select the audio clip first, then hit the marker — that beat-maps the music.
beat-map the music（对音乐踩点）
踩完之后，音频上就会出现对应的节奏点，剪视频时就能照着这个节奏点来卡点。
Once you're done, the audio shows the beat points, and you can cut right on them.
cut right on them（照着节奏点卡点）
paraphrase: Leave a reminder right where you'll need it.
Line every cut up to the beat.
scenes.speak: Think of it as sticking a sticky note onto the timeline. For example, mark a spot where you want to add an effect before you forget. Select the audio clip first, then hit the marker — that beat-maps the music. Once you're done, the audio shows the beat points, and you can cut right on them.

scenes.title_cn: 智能剪口播：自动去语气词
scenes.title_en: Smart Vlog Trimmer: Auto-Removing Filler Words
scenes.context: 录口播经常说错、卡壳、有语气词。以前得一帧一帧找再分割删除，现在把素材放时间线，点智能剪口播自动识别多余语气词、重复与停顿，一键删除，几分钟的活几秒搞定。
sentences: 以前剪这种口播视频呢，得一帧一帧的去找到这些地方，再分割删除，很麻烦。
Before, editing this kind of vlog meant hunting down every spot frame by frame, then splitting and deleting — a real pain.
frame by frame（一帧一帧）
它就会自动识别出多余的语气词、重复与停顿的地方，你点一下删除。
It automatically detects the filler words, repeats, and pauses — you just hit delete.
filler words（语气词/填充词）
几分钟的活几秒钟就能搞定，效率非常的快。
A job that took minutes now takes seconds — the efficiency is unreal.
takes seconds（几秒钟就能搞定）
paraphrase: Scanning second by second, looking for every mistake.
Clean it all up in a single click.
scenes.speak: Before, editing this kind of vlog meant hunting down every spot frame by frame, then splitting and deleting — a real pain. It automatically detects the filler words, repeats, and pauses — you just hit delete. A job that took minutes now takes seconds — the efficiency is unreal.

scenes.context: 轨道左侧图标：T=文字轨、小方块=视频轨、音乐图标=音乐轨。小锁=轨道锁定防误操作（长视频加音效时先锁定视频文字轨）；隐藏轨道清理视野；关闭原声；独奏=只监听某一条轨道的声 音，其他自动静音。
sentences: 比如你在加音效，因为整体素材太多，一不小心点到了视频或文字，排查起来会非常麻烦。
Say you're adding sound effects — with so many clips, one accidental click on a video or text and you're stuck troubleshooting.
troubleshooting（排查问题）
这时候就可以先锁定视频特效文字轨道，再一个一个的去添加音效，就不用担心误操作了。
So lock the video, effect, and text tracks first, then add each sound effect without worrying about accidental clicks.
accidental clicks（误操作）
打开这个轨道的独奏，其他轨道会自动静音，方便你快速监听。
Turn on solo for that track and everything else mutes automatically, so you can listen fast.
turn on solo（开启独奏）
paraphrase: Isolate one track and hear only it.
scenes.speak: Say you're adding sound effects — with so many clips, one accidental click on a video or text and you're stuck troubleshooting. So lock the video, effect, and text tracks first, then add each sound effect without worrying about accidental clicks. Turn on solo for that track and everything else mutes automatically, so you can listen fast.

scenes.context: ①鼠标放片段尾部变双括号拖动=调时长（缩短/延长）；②片段底部圆点变左右双头箭头往内拖=原声淡入淡出；③鼠标放音频中间横线变上下双头箭头=直接调音量。音乐波形突然结束很突兀，拉圆点淡出就自然。
sentences: 把鼠标放在片段尾部，鼠标会变成双括号的样子，按住左键拖动就可以调整片段的时长。
Hover the mouse at the clip's tail, it turns into double brackets, and dragging adjusts the clip's length.
double brackets（双括号）
把鼠标放在片段底部靠近边缘的位置，片段的头尾两端会出现一个亮起来的圆点。
Move the mouse to the bottom edge of the clip and a glowing dot appears at each end.
a glowing dot（亮起来的圆点）
把鼠标放在音频素材中间这条横线上，鼠标会变成上下双头箭头，上下拖动就能直接调整这段音频的音量大小。
Put the mouse on the horizontal line in the middle of the audio, it becomes a vertical double arrow, and dragging up or down adjusts the volume directly.
adjust the volume directly（直接调整音量）
paraphrase: Fade it out so it doesn't end with a bang.
scenes.speak: Hover the mouse at the clip's tail, it turns into double brackets, and dragging adjusts the clip's length. Move the mouse to the bottom edge of the clip and a glowing dot appears at each end. Put the mouse on the horizontal line in the middle of the audio, it becomes a vertical double arrow, and dragging up or down adjusts the volume directly.

practice: 在这个新版本上继续改，原版保留
Keep working on this new version while the original stays intact.
一键删除语气词和停顿
Delete the filler words and pauses in one click.
先锁定其他轨道再加音效
Lock the other tracks first, then add the sound effects.
拖动圆点让音乐结尾淡出
Drag the dot to fade the music out at the end.
pitfalls: 在原来的时间线上直接改版本，改坏了回不去
Copy the timeline before experimenting — the original never comes back once it's gone.
多时间线+复制粘贴=后悔药，原版永远保留。
要裁剪时先分割、再选中、再删除，绕远路
One click with Q or W cuts the edge in a single step.
向左裁剪Q/向右裁剪W一步到位。
电脑卡顿只能忍着，不知道关预览
Turn on disable-preview (S) and simplify the clip display.
关闭预览S+最简显示状态，剪辑立刻流畅。
移动主轨道时字幕音效跟着乱跑
Turn off linking so text and audio stay put.
关闭联动后文字音频独立不动，适合单独调整。
调音量非要进右侧面板
Drag the horizontal line on the audio clip to adjust volume.
鼠标变上下双头箭头直接拖，不用进面板。
shifts: 在一条时间线上死磕，改坏了回不去
多条时间线当独立工作区，原版永远保留
手动一帧帧找语气词再分割删除
智能剪口播一键识别删除，几分钟变几秒
卡顿只能忍/误操作只能排查
关预览+锁轨道，从源头杜绝卡顿和误触
footer_notes: ASR 校正：权选→全选、扩号→括号、读咒→独奏、减口波→剪口播、delay键→Delete键、卡麦利→Command。
